subject: Provisional rebate and co-sell incentive request — HearthTech AWS listing
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@hearthtech.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: provisional rebate + co-sell incentive for AWS listing

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. HearthTech is keen to list in the AWS Marketplace and to participate in the co-sell program, but our internal procurement team has flagged that the economics need a short-term incentive to justify switching from our incumbent.

Specifically: can Redwood provisionally approve a rebate or upfront credit that we can include in the PO to accelerate listing and co-sell onboarding? Our procurement deadline for vendor selection is May 20, and having a documented rebate or co-sell commitment in the PO materially helps our procurement/legal team move faster.

What we are asking: a provisional rebate/credit applied to the first 12 months (or an equivalent co-sell credit) that we can show in the private offer flow. We are flexible on structure — rebate vs. co-sell credit — as long as it is formalized in a signed offer.

Attached: HearthTech_Marketplace_SOW.pdf (scope & expected ARR).

Appreciate any quick guidance — happy to hop on a short call today.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of Partnerships | HearthTech
olivia.chen@hearthtech.com
+1 415-555-0183
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: provisional rebate + co-sell incentive for AWS listing

Laura / Aditya / Ben — looping you in for deal-desk escalation.

Summary: HearthTech (SMB/upper-mid market, projected $480k ARR in year 1 per attached SOW) wants a short-term incentive to unblock procurement & list in AWS Marketplace. Procurement deadline May 20.

Quick proposal from my side (to get the conversation started):
- Provisional rebate: 10% off list on first 12 months, applied via private-offer rebate line item OR
- Alternate: 8% co-sell credit applied to Redwood referral pool if they commit to 1-year term and publish before June 30.

Asks:
- Sales Ops / Deal Desk: confirm that private-offer rebate can be authored and held as a provisional DocuSign flow (we already have a template).
- Finance: quick note on accounting treatment for a rebate vs. co-sell credit (recognition impact).
- Legal: any standard language required to make this ‘provisional’ but binding once PO signed?

Attachments: DealPlan-HT-0427.xlsx (simple ARR/cost model).

Next steps: please reply with approvals/objections by EOD so I can get back to HearthTech. If we need a short sync, I can host 15m at 10:30.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: provisional rebate + co-sell incentive for AWS listing

Markus — appreciate the note and the model. A couple quick reactions:

- I’m generally supportive of offering a short-term incentive to close the listing, but 10% feels a touch high for an initial SMB/upper-mid book. Can we structure as 7% rebate + 5% co-sell credit (effectively equivalent economics but shifts some to marketing/co-sell incentives)?
- Approve in principle contingent on: signed 1-year commitment, PO references private-offer ID, and Marketplace PM signs off on listing timeline (we can’t reserve co-sell credits without their confirmation).
- Need Finance (cc’d) to confirm we can recognize the rebate as contra-revenue for year 1 and confirm cash-flow timing.

Markus — add a HubSpot note and link the DocuSign template once we have finance/legal language. If we can keep the total economic impact capped (net to us) at ~12% TCV equivalent, I’m ok to approve.

- Aditya
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marketplace Team <marketplace-team@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: provisional rebate + co-sell incentive for AWS listing

Looping in the Marketplace team — we need two things to make this operational:
1) Marketplace PM sign-off for a private-offer with a rebate line + confirmation we can publish before June 30.
2) Waiver for the standard listing fee (HearthTech’s SOW shows constrained budget).

Operationally, I recommend we do a Private Offer (rebate line) + a separate co-sell credit memo. That gives us flexibility to apply credit to partner co-sell budgets instead of altering Redwood public list prices.

Attaching PrivateOffer_Template.docx for Legal to review. If Marketplace PM confirms publish by June 30 and Finance signs off on the 7% rebate + 5% co-sell credit structure, we can proceed with DocuSign and get a provisional offer in front of HearthTech procurement.

Ben Carter
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@hearthtech.com>, procurement@hearthtech.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: provisional rebate + co-sell incentive for AWS listing

Olivia — quick update and provisional approval.

On Fri, May 7, 2027 at 08:12 AM Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@hearthtech.com> wrote:
> Hi Markus / Laura,
>
> Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. HearthTech is keen to list in the AWS Marketplace...

We’ve completed an internal review and can offer the following provisional terms to include in your PO and private-offer:

- Provisional rebate: 7% off list on month 1–12, applied via private-offer rebate line item.
- Co-sell credit: 5% of first-year ARR allocated to Redwood’s co-sell pool (applies when co-sell motion is executed).
- Conditions: 1-year minimum subscription, signed PO referencing private-offer ID, and listing published by June 30, 2027.
- Caveat: Final accounting/recognition language to be included in the DocuSign, and Finance will confirm final treatment.

Next steps for HearthTech:
1) Accept the provisional offer by signing the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/ht-provisional-offer
2) Share the PO referencing private-offer ID once signed.

If procurement needs tighter wording for the PO, we can provide Redwood’s standard rebate language for legal. We’ll keep this provisional approval open until May 20 to match your procurement deadline.

Thanks — will follow up once Finance/Marketplace confirm final template language.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
